surface_mechanism_description: Oxygen molecules break the chemical bonding between Ir atoms and organic ligands of Ir/H20849EtCp/H20850/H20849COD/H20850 but do not react with Ir atoms at a given O2 / (Ar+O2) ratio. The reaction path for the deposition of IrO2 is a direct reaction from Ir/H20849EtCp/H20850/H20849COD/H20850 to IrO2.
